roadmap.title: Opening story
roadmap.description: Play through the Incursion mission, then pick up the easy early unlocks: alarm-free outpost, camera tags, rock distractions and notes.

roadmap.title: Story and side content
roadmap.description: Continue the story while liberating outposts and Bell Towers, doing side quests, shopping, crafting and the combat challenges. Repel the 3 retaliation parties before you conquer Fortresses.

roadmap.title: Late story and cleanup
roadmap.description: Finish the story fates and ending, conquer Fortresses, then clear the remaining outposts, collectibles, skills and farm-style challenges in free roam.

roadmap.title: Co-op, online and Valley of the Yetis
roadmap.description: Arrange co-op and public multiplayer sessions, and play the Valley of the Yetis DLC.

achievements.description: Join the Golden Path (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Finish the Incursion story mission by taking over the first outpost.

steps.text: Play the story to the @loc{Incursion} mission and liberate the outpost.
Shoot the gate of the elephant cage so the elephant clears the outpost for you.

achievements.description: Decide De Pleur's fate (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Finish the City of Pain story mission to decide Paul De Pleur's fate.

guide.context: Your Amita or Sabal choice only changes the side goal: photograph the interrogation rooms for Amita, or rescue hostages for Sabal.

steps.text: Sneak into the compound on the shipment truck without being detected.
Reach @npc{De Pleur}'s office, then carry him out and put him in the car trunk.
Drive to the final marker.

achievements.description: Discover Shangri-La (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Reach Shangri-La for the first time in The Protector's Arrival story mission.

steps.text: Play the story through @loc{The Protector's Arrival}.

achievements.description: Decide Noore's fate (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Finish the Shoot the Messenger story mission to decide Noore's fate.

steps.text: Fast travel to @loc{Shanath} arena and use the grapple point above the main entrance.
In the control room, press the buttons to release the animals, then climb out of the pit and reach @npc{Noore}.
Watch the scene that ends the mission.

achievements.description: Decide Yuma's fate (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Finish the Payback story mission to decide Yuma's fate.

steps.text: Enter the abandoned gold mine and finish the mission through the fight with @enemy{Kalinag}.
Hit @enemy{Kalinag} with an arrow, then do the takedown. Repeat for each phase.

achievements.description: Decide Pagan Min's fate (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Finish the story ending to decide Pagan Min's fate.

guide.context: Any ending works.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Ashes to Ashes}, then drive to the palace.
Choose any ending: shoot @npc{Pagan Min}, or wait and let him show you Lakshmana.

achievements.description: Liberate 12 Outposts (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Liberate 12 outposts.

steps.text: Kill every enemy inside an outpost to liberate it. Repeat until 12 are liberated.

achievements.description: Liberate all Outposts (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Liberate all 24 outposts.

steps.text: Liberate every outpost on the map, 24 in total.
To redo one you missed, use the @mechanic{Outpost Master} icon on the map.

achievements.description: Liberate any Outpost without triggering an alarm in any mode (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Liberate any outpost without an alarm going off.

guide.context: If an alarm goes off, die and respawn near the outpost, or replay it from @mechanic{Outpost Master}.

steps.text: Pick an outpost with a single alarm, such as @loc{Kyra Tea Weigh Station}.
Disable each alarm: shoot the box at the bottom of the pole, or hold the interact button on it.
Kill the remaining enemies. Being seen does not matter if no alarm sounds.

achievements.description: Liberate 8 Bell Towers (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Liberate 8 Bell Towers.

steps.text: Climb a Bell Tower and use the radio equipment at the top. Repeat until 8 are liberated.

achievements.description: Conquer 2 Fortresses (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Conquer 2 Fortresses.

guide.context: Repel 3 Outpost Retaliation Parties before you conquer Fortresses.

steps.text: Take over two of the four Fortresses: @loc{Varshakot}, @loc{Baghadur}, @loc{Ratu Gadhi} and @loc{Rajgad Gulad}.
Kill the leader of a Fortress first to make it easier.

achievements.description: Complete any 6 Hunting quests (Supplies, Control, Survival) (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Complete 6 Hunting quests of any type.

guide.context: They appear as you liberate outposts, Bell Towers and Fortresses.

steps.text: Take Hunting quests (Supplies, Control or Survival) from the map and finish 6 in any mix.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Assassination or Eye for an Eye quests (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Finish 3 quests of the Assassination or Eye for an Eye kind.

steps.text: Do Assassination quests by killing the commander without being detected.
Do Eye for an Eye quests by killing the target with the weapon type the quest asks for.
Finish 3 in any mix.

achievements.description: Rescue 15 hostages in Hostage Rescue quests (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Save 15 hostages across Hostage Rescue quests in total.

steps.text: Do Hostage Rescue quests and stay unseen so the enemies do not kill the hostages.
Each quest has 4 hostages and you must save at least 2. Repeat until 15 are saved in total.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Kyrati Films: Racing or Kyrati Films: Survival activities (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Complete 3 Kyrati Films: Racing or Survival quests.

guide.context: Winning one Racing quest also unlocks the Vehicle Takedown skill.

steps.text: Visit @npc{Sharma Salsa} to unlock the Kyrati Films quests.
Finish 3 Racing or Survival quests in any mix.

achievements.description: Repel 3 Outpost Retaliation Parties (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Repel 3 Outpost Retaliation Parties at liberated outposts.

guide.context: Missable: conquering a Fortress stops attacks in that region. Finish this before you conquer Fortresses.

steps.text: Walk or drive away from your liberated outposts until you see that the nearest outpost is under attack.
Go there and kill every attacker. Repeat 3 times.

achievements.description: Hijack 3 Royal Cargo Trucks and return them to a liberated Outpost (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Hijack 3 Royal Cargo Trucks and bring each to a liberated outpost.

steps.text: Find a blue Royal Cargo Truck on the map. Kill the driver, ideally with an explosion that leaves the truck intact.
Drive it into a liberated outpost. Repeat 3 times.

achievements.description: Eliminate 3 Pagan's Wrath convoys (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Eliminate 3 Pagan's Wrath convoys.

steps.text: Ambush a convoy: plant C4 on a straight road and detonate it between the vehicles.
Kill every enemy in all three vehicles, shooting the gunner before the driver. Repeat 3 times.

achievements.description: Liberate 1 Outpost playing as Hurk (Campaign Co-op only).
achievements.summary: Liberate an outpost as Hurk in a co-op campaign.

guide.context: Co-op unlocks after the @loc{Incursion} mission. The host plays Ajay, the joiner plays Hurk. The host can reset outposts in the settings if all are already liberated.

steps.text: Join another player's co-op campaign from the main menu so you play as @npc{Hurk}.
Liberate an outpost in their game.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Bomb Defusal quests (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Complete 3 Bomb Defusal quests.

steps.text: Take Bomb Defusal quests from the map and defuse at least 2 bombs in each.
Stay undetected: if enemies spot you, they start a timer that fails the quest at zero.

achievements.description: Perform a Vehicle Takedown from the passenger seat of a vehicle (Campaign Co-op only).
achievements.summary: Perform a Vehicle Takedown from a vehicle's passenger seat in co-op.

guide.context: Outpost reinforcement vehicles and convoys give you targets.

steps.text: Learn the @mechanic{Vehicle Takedown} skill (Tiger tree, 2 points) after winning a Kyrati Films: Racing quest.
Join a co-op campaign. Sit in the passenger seat while the driver pulls beside an enemy vehicle, driver's door to driver's door.
Press the takedown prompt.

achievements.description: Purchase 3 items for the Ghale Homestead (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Buy 3 items for the Ghale Homestead.

steps.text: After @loc{The Protector's Arrival}, talk to the vendor outside the Homestead front door.
Buy any 3 items. The cheapest are Water Faucet (25,000), Trading Post (50,000) and the Exterior or Interior Upgrade (75,000 each).

achievements.description: Destroy 15 Masks of Yalung (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Destroy 15 Masks of Yalung.

steps.text: Buy collectible maps from a vendor to mark masks on the map.
Destroy 15 masks. There are 55 in total.

achievements.description: Remove 30 Propaganda Posters (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Remove 30 Propaganda Posters.

steps.text: Buy collectible maps from a vendor to mark posters on the map.
Walk up to a poster and press the prompt to remove it. Remove 30 of the 150.

achievements.description: Find 10 Lost Letters (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Find 10 Lost Letters.

steps.text: Buy collectible maps from a vendor to mark letters on the map.
Pick up 10 of the 20 letters.

achievements.description: Spin 10 Mani Wheels (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Spin 10 Mani Wheels.

steps.text: Buy collectible maps from a vendor to mark wheels on the map.
Spin 10 of the 40 bronze wheels.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Kyrat Fashion Week quests (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Complete 3 Kyrat Fashion Week quests.

steps.text: Visit the elephant-head icon on the map to meet @npc{Mumu} and unlock the quests.
For each quest, kill the rare animal asked for and loot its skin. Finish 3.

achievements.description: Read 10 notes (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Read 10 notes.

steps.text: Pick up and read notes found around Kyrat until the Progress tab shows 10.

achievements.description: Learn 10 skills (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Learn 10 skills.

steps.text: Spend skill points on any 10 skills. You earn a point every 2,000 XP.

achievements.description: Learn all skills (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Learn every skill.

steps.text: Buy every skill in both trees, including every level of Karma Boosts, Focus Syringe - Duration Boosts, Healing Syringe - Duration Boosts and Hunting Syringe - Duration Boosts.
Reach Karma level 4 for the skill that needs it.

achievements.description: Craft 5 upgrades for your equipment (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Craft 5 equipment upgrades.

guide.context: Kills by explosion or fire leave no skin.

steps.text: Kill animals with a bow or knife for double skins, then craft upgrades in the crafting menu.
Easy first picks: Weapon Holster, Wallet, Loot Bag, Syringe Kit and Ammo Bag.

achievements.description: Craft 15 syringes (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Craft 15 syringes.

guide.context: The first syringe type, healing, needs two Green Leaves. Other types need their skills.

steps.text: Pick plants, then craft syringes of any type from the weapon wheel's syringe tab. Craft 15.

achievements.description: Spend 500,000 rupees total at Trading Posts (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Spend 500,000 rupees at Trading Posts.

steps.text: Buy weapons and ammo at Trading Posts, including safehouse cabinets and wandering traders, until the total reaches 500,000.

achievements.description: Buy all attachments and paint schemes for a single weapon (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Buy every attachment and paint scheme for one weapon.

steps.text: Choose a weapon with no attachments, such as the AK-47.
Buy all 6 AK-47 paint schemes at a store for 200,000 rupees total.

achievements.description: Kill 30 enemies with an elephant (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Kill 30 enemies with an elephant.

steps.text: Learn the @mechanic{Elephant Rider} skill (2 points).
Ride an elephant and kill enemies with its attacks. @loc{Shanath Breeders Outpost} has an elephant pen, and the outpost can be replayed.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies simultaneously with a single explosion (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Kill 4 enemies at once with one explosion.

steps.text: Buy an RPG (the RPG-7 costs 160,000 rupees).
Set off an outpost alarm and shoot the reinforcement vehicle that carries 4 soldiers before they get out.

achievements.description: Distract 15 enemies with rocks (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Distract 15 different enemies with thrown rocks.

guide.context: Replay an outpost from @mechanic{Outpost Master} for fresh targets.

steps.text: Throw a rock (default T) near an unaware enemy and wait until they walk back to their original spot.
Use one rock per enemy. Distract 15 different enemies; a repeat on the same enemy does not count.

achievements.description: Tag 25 enemies using the camera (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Tag 25 enemies with the camera.

steps.text: Equip the camera (default Z) and aim at 25 different enemies to tag them.

achievements.description: Kill 30 enemies with Mortar rounds (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Kill 30 enemies with mortar rounds.

steps.text: Use the mortar in the middle of @loc{Pranijagat School} outpost.
Fire at enemies and reinforcements. Replay the outpost to kill more.

achievements.description: Kill a target from 60m or more with an arrow or bolt (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with an arrow or bolt from 60 metres or more.

steps.text: Buy the Recurve Bow and Marksman Sight (84,000 rupees together).
Put a map marker on a still enemy, such as one outside @loc{Rochan Brick Co. Shipping Outpost}, and walk away until the marker shows 60 m or more.
Shoot, allowing for arrow drop.

achievements.description: Using a sniper rifle, kill 2 targets with a single shot (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Kill 2 enemies with one sniper rifle shot.

guide.context: If you miss, die and respawn at the outpost or replay it.

steps.text: Buy a sniper rifle and go to @loc{Pranijagat School} outpost.
Approach from the south, climb the small building and headshot the two enemies standing side by side.

achievements.description: Perform a takedown from a Buzzer (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Perform a Vehicle Takedown from a Buzzer.

guide.context: A Death From Above takedown does not count.

steps.text: Learn the @mechanic{Vehicle Takedown} skill (2 points) after winning a Kyrati Films: Racing quest.
Fly a Buzzer from the airport or @loc{Khilana Bazaar} outpost beside the driver's door of a moving enemy vehicle, such as a cargo truck.
Press the takedown prompt.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies with fire (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies with fire.

steps.text: Use the flamethrower, fire arrows or Molotovs. Replay outposts for more targets.

achievements.description: Kill 25 enemies while shooting and driving (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies while shooting from the driver's seat.

steps.text: Drive a vehicle and shoot enemies with a sidearm. The vehicle may be stopped.

achievements.description: Reach Karma Level 2, and purchase any Guns For Hire upgrade (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Reach Karma level 2, then purchase any Guns For Hire item upgrade.

steps.text: Earn 2,200 Karma from Karma events, Mani Wheels and clean animal kills.
In any store's Items tab, pay for a Guns For Hire upgrade; the cheapest is 50,000 rupees.

achievements.description: Fly 5000m total in the Wingsuit (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Fly 5,000 metres in total in the Wingsuit.

steps.text: Pick up the Wingsuit once you finish @loc{Sermon on the Mount}.
Glide from high ground, such as the cliffs near the Ghale Homestead, until the total reaches 5,000 m.

achievements.description: Run over 25 people (Campaign only).
achievements.summary: Run over and kill 25 enemies.

steps.text: Drive into enemies on foot, at Karma events and at unliberated outposts. Each must die.

achievements.description: Reach Arena Rank 5 (Campaign Arena only).
achievements.summary: Reach Arena Rank 5 in the campaign arena.

steps.text: After @loc{The Mouth of Madness}, go to the arena at @loc{Shanath} and speak to the woman there to enter.
Play Battles matches; you gain rank even if you lose. About 5 matches are enough.

achievements.description: Finish a public match of each game type in the Battles of Kyrat game mode (Battles of Kyrat only).
achievements.summary: Finish a public Battles of Kyrat match in each of the three game types.

guide.context: Private matches do not count. Matchmaking is nearly empty, so arrange a group of 6 players ahead of time.

steps.text: From the main menu, enter the Battles of Kyrat mode and choose Public Match.
Finish one Outpost, one Demon Mask and one Propaganda match. Each needs 3 players per side.

achievements.description: Play a Top Rated map in the Map Browser (Map Browser only).
achievements.summary: Start a map from the Top Rated list in the Map Browser.

steps.text: Open Map Browser on the main menu and choose Top Rated, or Quick Play Top Rated.
Download and play the map. Dying and failing it also counts.

achievements.description: Occupy The Relay Station (Valley Of The Yetis).
achievements.summary: Occupy the Relay Station in Valley of the Yetis.

guide.context: Needs the Valley of the Yetis DLC.

steps.text: Play the Valley of the Yetis story until you occupy the @loc{Relay Station}.

achievements.description: Defend The Relay Station And Survive The First Night (Valley Of The Yetis).
achievements.summary: Defend the Relay Station through the first night in Valley of the Yetis.

guide.context: Needs the Valley of the Yetis DLC.

steps.text: Play the story through the first-night defence of the @loc{Relay Station} and survive.

achievements.description: Complete One Relay Station Upgrade Quest (Valley Of The Yetis, Single Player Only).
achievements.summary: Complete one Relay Station upgrade quest in Valley of the Yetis single player.

guide.context: Needs the Valley of the Yetis DLC. Single player only.

steps.text: After the First Night mission, take an upgrade quest marked with an exclamation point on the map and finish it.

achievements.description: Complete All Relay Station Upgrade Quests (Valley Of The Yetis, Single Player Only).
achievements.summary: Complete all Relay Station upgrade quests in Valley of the Yetis single player.

guide.context: Needs the Valley of the Yetis DLC. Single player only.

steps.text: Finish all 9 upgrade quests marked with exclamation points on the map.

achievements.description: Complete The Valley Of The Yetis Campaign (Valley Of The Yetis).
achievements.summary: Finish the main story of the Valley of the Yetis DLC.

guide.context: Needs the Valley of the Yetis DLC.

steps.text: Play every story mission of the DLC to the end.

achievements.description: Kill A Yeti (Valley Of The Yetis, Single Player Only).
achievements.summary: Kill one Yeti in Valley of the Yetis single player.

guide.context: Needs the Valley of the Yetis DLC. Single player only.

steps.text: Shoot a @enemy{Yeti} with explosives or an LMG. When it staggers, use a takedown or keep shooting.

achievements.description: Kill 5 Yetis (Valley Of The Yetis, Single Player Only).
achievements.summary: Kill 5 Yetis in Valley of the Yetis single player.

guide.context: Needs the Valley of the Yetis DLC. Single player only.

steps.text: Kill 5 @enemy{Yeti} with explosives or an LMG. Most die during the story.
